auth.heroSubtitle: Book visits, get reminders and see your treatment plans and invoices — anytime.
auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to manage your appointments.
auth.registerSubtitle: It takes less than a minute. We'll text you a code to confirm your mobile.
auth.phoneHelper: We'll send the code to WhatsApp
auth.codeSentTo: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{phone}}.
auth.terms: By creating an account you agree to the Terms of service and Privacy policy.

home.subtitle: How can we help your smile today?
home.noUpcomingHint: Book a visit with your dentist in a few taps.
home.linkBody: Already a patient at a clinic on ElDental? Link your file to see your appointments, plans and invoices here. The clinic will confirm it with a code sent to the phone they have on file.
home.tip: Brush twice a day for two minutes and book a check-up and cleaning every six months.

site.title: Your dental care, simplified
site.subtitle: Book appointments online, get reminders on WhatsApp, review your treatment plans and keep every invoice in one place — for you and your family.

b1.title: Book online, 24/7
b1.body: See real free times for your dentist and book in four simple steps — no phone calls.

b2.title: Reminders that help
b2.body: Get a WhatsApp or email reminder before every visit, and confirm with one tap.

b3.title: Understand your treatment
b3.body: Review your treatment plan, the cost estimate and insurance share, then accept it with your signature.

b4.title: Invoices & receipts
b4.body: Every invoice and receipt in one place, ready to download as a PDF.

b5.title: The whole family
b5.body: Parents can manage their children's appointments from the same account.

b6.title: Private & secure
b6.body: Your records are encrypted and only you and your clinic can see them.

h1.title: Create your account
h1.body: Your name and mobile number — we confirm it with a code.

h2.title: Link your clinic
h2.body: Connect the file your clinic already has for you.

h3.title: Book and relax
h3.body: Pick a time, get reminders and arrive ready.

site.ctaBody: Create your free patient account in under a minute.

book.title: Book an appointment
book.subtitle: Choose a service and a time that suits you. The clinic confirms your visit.
book.noClinics: No clinics take online bookings yet
book.noClinicsHint: Please call your clinic to book.
book.newFile: A new file will be opened for you at this clinic
book.noServices: This clinic has no services open for online booking.
book.noSlots: No free times on this day
book.noSlotsHint: Try another day, week or dentist.
book.notesHint: Optional, e.g. what is bothering you.
book.rules: You can cancel online up to {{hours}} hours before the visit.

appointments.title: My appointments
appointments.subtitle: Upcoming visits for you and your family, and your history.
appointments.tooLate: Less than {{hours}} hours to go: please call the clinic to change this visit.
appointments.cancelBody: Your visit on {{date}} with {{dentist}} will be cancelled and the time released.

plans.title: Treatment plans
plans.subtitle: Plans your dentist shared with you, with costs and what insurance covers.
plans.emptyHint: When your dentist shares a plan, you can review and approve it here.
plans.acceptBody: Untick anything you do not want to go ahead with now. Your signature confirms your consent.
plans.consent: I have read the plan, understand the treatments and the estimated costs, and agree to go ahead.
plans.accepted: Thank you. The clinic has your approval.

billing.title: Invoices & payments
billing.subtitle: Your balance, invoices and receipts at each clinic.

family.title: Family & files
family.subtitle: Your clinic files and the family members you manage.
family.none: No clinic files are linked to your account yet. Link your file below, or simply book: a file is opened for you at your first visit.

link.title: Link a clinic file
link.body: Already a patient? Enter the clinic code and your file number. We send a code to the phone the clinic has on file.
link.clinicHint: Ask the clinic, or pick one below.
link.fileNumberHint: Printed on your invoices and receipts, e.g. P-000123.

child.title: Add a child
child.body: Add a child or dependant to your file so you can book and follow their care.

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: Your details and sign-in.
profile.name: Full name
profile.phoneHint: Your verified sign-in number. Contact the clinic to change it.

documents.title: My documents
documents.subtitle: Medical certificates and care instructions from your clinics.
